results.title: A dossier over a large featureset estate
results.evidence: one parameter set, one dossier build, an estate of 20 featureset(s): 1 full scan(s) of the register and 20 version read(s), 6 ms. The cost is O(parameter sets x featuresets x versions) per build, with the register read whole each time and no index on `featureset_version.id` being used — a screen that is quick here and is not on a bank's estate
